_about: Known, documented exceptions that sites-ci accepts (read by .github/scripts/ci-build.mjs; CODEOWNERS-protected under /.github/, so a site PR cannot widen its own allowance). (1) Strict: the plain build must always have zero problems; `engine/build.mjs <dir> --strict --json` may fail ONLY with the rule ids listed for that target (sites.<slug>.allow[].rule; templates.<type>.expect + allow). A strict problem with any other rule fails CI; a listed rule that no longer occurs is reported as stale. `templates.<type>.expect` lists rules a type's template-site MUST still fail strict with (D-09: a template is never launchable as-is). The PR label `placeholders-ok` additionally allows `placeholder` for any site (SPEC 11.1). Remove a site's entry at launch: `/ship` requires a clean strict build. (2) skipVariants: pack build variants (pack.checks.builds) not built for a target, each with a reason and the owner who must remove it.

allow.reason: operator company name, number and address are still placeholders (owner question)
Pragmatic Play written consent not yet recorded (pragmatic.writtenConsent)
demo facts not yet confirmed from a UK browser (data/pragmatic-games.json checked dates)

skipVariants.name: pragmatic
skipVariants.reason: the template ships with demos off and an empty demo list; with pragmatic.enabled forced on, the build now reports sc.pragmatic-empty (an error by design) instead of crashing. The pragmatic variant applies to sites that have demo data.
skipVariants.until: permanent for the template (it never carries demo data)
